## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -2.59% | 1M: -6.69%) ↓ falling and SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +0.94%) vs TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -4.41%) ↑ rising on stocks-vs-bonds confirm a risk-tilt, while HYG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -2.02%) & LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -2.94%) signal credit stress, creating a neutral mix.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Fear DECREASING: VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -2.59% | 1M: -6.69%) ↓ falling. Stocks vs Bonds showing risk bias: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +0.94%) vs TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -4.41%) ↑ rising. Credit stress RISING: HYG (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -2.02%) & LQD (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -2.94%) → showing strain.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-tighter: UUP ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.49% | 1M: +1.56%) → flat / ABOVE TREND (Dollar strength) while TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -4.41%) ↓ falling (higher yields) and the yield curve is flattening (↓ falling).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Technology leading: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.64% | 1M: +7.47%) and QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.30% | 1M: +4.77%); Financials showing weakness: XLF BELOW TREND (1W: -1.08% | 1M: -5.56%). Style: Growth/Momentum showing relative strength given tech leadership and sector breadth tilt.

5. US vs Global?  
US outperforms: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +0.94%); Europe VGK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.41% | 1M: -3.89%) and China FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -1.05% | 1M: -4.47%) lag, while EM EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.42% | 1M: +1.21%) shows selective strength.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculative flows intact: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +7.00%) and ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +5.82%) while small-caps IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.75% | 1M: -5.43%) remain weak.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Copper/industrial signals mixed but constructive: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.94% | 1M: +1.37%) ↑ rising, while Gold GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -6.62%) ↓ falling shows risk-on preference and profit taking in safe-havens.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy mixed to weak: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -2.96% | 1M: -0.03%) ↓ falling while NatGas UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.92% | 1M: +6.92%) ↑ rising and oil BNO in CORRECTION (1W: -1.52% | 1M: +18.03%) shows divergent commodity flows.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Tech leadership—XLK and QQQ both ABOVE TREND (XLK 1W: +3.64% | 1M: +7.47%; QQQ 1W: +3.30% | 1M: +4.77%). DIVERGENCE: Credit (HYG & LQD BELOW TREND) and narrow breadth (3/11) mute a full risk-on conviction.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor growth/tech exposure (XLK, QQQ) while reducing exposure to cyclical/defensive laggards (XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -2.96% | 1M: -0.03%), XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -3.16% | 1M: -8.53%)); monitor HYG (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -2.02%) and LQD (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -2.94%) for worsening credit signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Technology — XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.64% | 1M: +7.47%) if QQQ/XLK momentum holds. BEARISH: Energy — XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -2.96% | 1M: -0.03%) if oil momentum in BNO rolls over.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Natural gas — UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.92% | 1M: +6.92%). BEARISH: Gold — GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -6.62%) if risk-on continues.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold); HYG/LQD ~0.75 (credit health); SPY/TLT ~9.7 (stocks vs bonds tilt); Breadth 3/11 (narrow market, watch for expansion).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive, mixed signals from falling VXX and rising SPY/TLT offset by HYG/LQD credit stress. Tech (XLK, QQQ) showing relative strength while credit metrics and narrow breadth are key divergences to monitor.
